# Anubhav Gain

> Senior DevSecOps Engineer and Security Engineer specializing in Rust, Linux, and cybersecurity. Builds security automation, threat detection, and EDR/XDR systems. Security Software Engineer at Infopercept Consulting and founder/CEO at TechAnv Consulting, based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India.

## About
- Roles: DevSecOps Engineer, Security Engineer, Rust Developer
- Focus areas: security automation, YARA rule development, threat detection, container and Kubernetes security, CI/CD security, EDR/XDR platform engineering, secure systems architecture
- Core stack: Rust, Go, Bash, Linux
- Education: Parul University
